item.text: The failure is behavioral, not tooling: `runSequential` currently uses `Promise.all(tasks.map(...))`, so both tasks start immediately and the faster second task records `b` before `a`. Minimal edit: replace the parallel `Promise.all` mapping with a simple awaited loop that starts each task only after the previous one resolves, preserving result order.
The implementation now starts each task inside an awaited loop and collects results in call order. I’m running the same command, `npm test`, as the focused verification requested by the harness.
